result.rationale: The diff lowercases the blacklist ('BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS.split(',').map((email) => email.toLowerCase())') but compares '!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)' with the original-case guest, so 'Bad@Example.com' bypasses a blacklisted 'bad@example.com'. Likewise the duplicate check '!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)' is case-sensitive, allowing 'John@Example.com' when 'john@example.com' already attends. Both defects are directly visible in addGuests.handler.ts.
